about: Facts from the suppliers' product pages, collected 2026-10-16: Fraterworks (note classification, average use, odour family, longevity) and PerfumersWorld (odour profile, typical use from/average/maximum in a perfume compound, odour life, relative impact, usage keywords, 'blends well with').
Only facts and keyword lists are kept; each profile links to the product page for the supplier's own description.
Supplier usage figures are guidance for a perfume compound (concentrate), not IFRA limits. IFRA limits still apply.

Left out because the product couldn't be identified with certainty: Labdanum Absolute 50% TEC and Ylang Ylang "Superior" Oil (Fraterworks), Pink Peppercorn "Molle" Oil (no longer listed), Safranal (only a 1% dilution is listed; Jin's is neat).
